qualityRules: Questions must be original practice questions, never claimed to be leaked or actual PRC questions.
Stay within the official PRC Agriculturists Licensure Examination TOS.
Prefer application, analysis, computation, diagnosis, and scenario questions over trivia.
Exactly four plausible options; only one best answer.
Give a concise main explanation and a separate explanation for each option.
Do not use 'all of the above' or 'none of the above'.
Avoid obscure numerical facts unless they are directly supported by official source material.
Philippine laws, programs, dates, rates, or current policies must be source-supported.
Do not duplicate or lightly paraphrase an existing question.
If a fact is uncertain or contested, do not create a question from it.
